defects: `s.posPart` and `s.negPart` are not fields of `SignedMeasure` — `posPart`/`negPart` belong to `JordanDecomposition`, reached only via `s.toJordanDecomposition.posPart` / `s.toJordanDecomposition.negPart`; as written this does not elaborate

even granting the intended meaning, `posPart`/`negPart` are `Measure α` (ℝ≥0∞-valued), so `s.posPart i - s.negPart i` would use truncated ℝ≥0∞ subtraction rather than real subtraction, and would not have type ℝ to match `s i`; the gold's `.real` conversion (Measure.real, mapping to ℝ via toReal) is missing, which is not merely cosmetic since ℝ≥0∞ truncated subtraction differs from real subtraction
